traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are met with concrete implementation and tests: - File-level @supports annotations in test files are enforced by ensureFileSupportsAnnotation, with safe auto-fix placeholders (REQ-TEST-FILE-SUPPORTS, REQ-TEST-SUPPORTS-VALID via other rules). - describe() blocks in test files must include a story reference matching a configurable pattern, with default matching the `"Story 0XX.X-..."` style (REQ-TEST-DESCRIBE-STORY). - it()/test() names in test files must begin with a `[REQ-XXX]` prefix; malformed prefixes are normalized when possible, otherwise an error is reported (REQ-TEST-IT-REQ-PREFIX). - Test file detection is implemented via configurable `testFilePatterns` with sensible defaults, and there is explicit test coverage for both test and non-test paths (REQ-TEST-PATTERN-DETECT). - The rule recognizes multiple test-framework constructs (`describe`, `it`, `test`, `context`) while enforcing conventions on the core Jest/Mocha patterns, and avoids false positives for non-test files (REQ-TEST-FRAMEWORK-COMPAT). - The rule is integrated into the plugin’s dynamic rule loading, recommended/strict configs, and is documented in both the README and user-docs API reference, including options and examples (Integration, Documentation, Quality Standards ACs). - Jest tests dedicated to this story (tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts) expressly reference docs/stories/020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md and pass, demonstrating the behavior specified in the story.
Given this evidence, the story is fully implemented and verified: status PASSED.
